Question 21(a) [2 marks]: Outline how this customer can be considered an input in the construction of the new home.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
A building company has been contracted to build a new home for a customer. The contract requires the home to be completed within six months and within budget.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 2):
2 marks: Sketches in general terms how this customer is an input in the construction of the new home
1 marks: Makes a relevant statement about inputs in the construction of a new home

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Customers are a transformed resource in the operations process. If the customer provides information to the builder about, for example, the materials, paint colours, or size of the house, they are acting as an input in the construction of the new home.



WHAT THE REAL MARKERS SAID ABOUT THIS QUESTION:
Better responses: apply their theoretical knowledge of the Operations function to the stimulus business scenario
Better responses: understand the ways in which the customer impacts the operations process as an input (a)
Better responses: apply knowledge of sequencing and scheduling (b)
Better responses: explain two different quality management strategies and show the likely effects of these strategies (c).
To improve: referencing the business identified in the question scenario
To improve: understanding the impact of the customer on the operations process (a)
To improve: recognising the terms of the contract from the information supplied and explaining how a Gantt chart could be used to help the company meet those terms (b)
To improve: understanding of specific quality management strategies and the ways these strategies are used to ensure quality outputs when work is outsourced as in this case or carried out internally (c).
